workflow-metadata.description: Data-prep workflow v2 for Beyond the Road Toll (portable: national xlsx bundled in data/). R1 read, R2 Traffic, R5 missing to 0; Idea 1 yearly index; Idea 2 pedal cyclists 65-74; Idea 3 severity (died per 1,000 2011-19, case vs bed-day shares 2016-21); Idea 4 lockdown (April 2019 vs 2020 by road user, cyclists per year). Outputs are written to the workflow data area (data/).
